name: Karahman Sticky Cart
author: Karahman

sections.description:
**Adds a sticky Add to Cart bar to WooCommerce product pages. Lightweight, fast, and boosts conversions.

Features:
* Sticky Add to Cart button on single product pages
* Customize button text, colors, and appearance
* Show product price and quantity field inside the sticky bar
* Works with simple products
* Lightweight and optimized

Upgrade to Karahman Sticky Cart Pro for:
* Smart display rules (show only on mobile, user role, time, etc.)
* Sticky bar on shop and category pages
* Custom themes and animation effects
* Analytics and click tracking
* Product image preview inside the bar
* And more!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/karahman-sticky-cart directory, or install the plugin via the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin via Sticky Cart in the admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with variable products?

Not yet — the free version supports simple products only. Variable support is coming in the Pro version.

Can I customize the appearance of the sticky bar?

Yes! You can change button text, colors, and font sizes from the plugin settings page.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Absolutely. The sticky bar is responsive and works on all screen sizes.
